messages:
maria: Quick kick-off: Solstice-13B-v2 + EdgeCore Lite bundle request. Need redistribution terms, bundle SKU, embargo window, and who owns on-prem support. Keeping it lean.

riley (Legal): We need a redistribution addendum signed pre-publish and a consumer-facing license blurb. Draft language (short):
Redistribution Addendum: Solstice grants Redwood a limited right to distribute the Model Artifact for marketplace delivery and customer installs. Redistribution must include original license and provenance metadata. Customers accept Model Usage Notice at checkout.

sam: Packaging constraints from EdgeCore: accept .whl, OCI image, or signed tar.gz. We require a top-level provenance.json with keys: model_release, quant_profile, provenance_sha256, license_uri. Example: {"model_release":"solstice-13b-v2","quant_profile":"int8-ptq","provenance_sha256":"3b7f...","license_uri":"https://solstice.ai/licenses/solstice-13b-v2.txt"} If OCI isn't possible, signed tarball + SHA256.

katie (GTM): Proposed embargo: 2027-02-10 08:00 PT. GTM needs 150-word listing copy + 3 screenshots by 2027-01-18. Partner wants a 1-week co-marketing window and one joint webinar.

devrel: I'll produce two quickstarts: OCI->k8s and wheel->edgecore local. Each includes a smoke test that runs a sample prompt and verifies output. Repos under redwood-examples/solstice-edgecore. ETA 2027-01-25.

punit: Compliance asks: include an attest.pem (signed attestation) in the bundle and an approvals checkbox for any benchmark claims. Also export-control screening for EdgeCore country list.

infra-bot: task created PARTNERS-4907 assigned to riley,sam,katie,devrel,punit. Due 2027-01-18.

maria: Owners recap: Legal (riley) -> addendum & consumer notice; Eng (sam) -> packaging + manifest; GTM (katie) -> assets & copy; DevRel (devrel) -> quickstarts; Compliance (punit) -> provenance & attestations. Reply with 'ack' + ETA.

riley (Legal): ack  draft by 2026-12-05, final by 2026-12-22.

sam: ack  manifest schema & packaging plan by 2026-12-08; will confirm int4 redistribution permission by 2026-12-10.

katie (GTM): ack  assets + copy by 2027-01-18; will request logo pack from Solstice by 2026-12-15.

devrel: ack  quickstarts + CI by 2027-01-25.

punit: ack  attest.pem spec + export check by 2026-12-12.

maria: Thanks  I'll schedule a 20m sync after the legal redline lands. If eng needs license fields clarified ping @riley.
